name: deriv
scope: Original full workload, fresh processes, default V8 tiering; setup excluded and final predicate included.

rust.name: deriv
rust.setup_excluded: stdin read/parse; deriv also parses the complete supplied input and expected expression before its clock
rust.predicate_boundary: final original equality is included; report calls start.elapsed before formatting Result/CSV, leaving the final owned result alive

inspection.notes: main retains a derivative call in its repeated loop; recursive derivative retains calls, allocations and Rc destruction. Exact WAT and artifact hashes are retained.

correctness.predicate: complete recursive structural equality with supplied expected expression
correctness.independent_small_wrong_checks: later current-reader artifact checks are separate; the frozen historical report establishes exact full-input equality, no additional small/wrong run was created for this handoff

rust.timed: 10,000,000 complete derivative constructions, per-iteration ownership assignment/drop of the previous tree and final complete structural equality
rust.representation: Number(i64), Symbol(Rc<str>), Operation(Rc<Operation>) with Vec argument lists; compound input subtrees retain identity and sharing through Rc clones; newly generated derivative nodes own fresh argument buffers; immediate reference counting/drop versus Scheme tracing GC
rust.opacity: black_box of input-expression reference and complete returned derivative on every iteration; no additional timed validation; differs from common.scm hide allocation/effects
rust.source_semantics: Same recursive differentiation and unsimplified product-rule expression. Preserve the original deliberately incorrect quotient rule. Canonical input has no input quotient. Finite i64 arithmetic-expression atoms and +,-,*,/ operators are the explicit supported domain, versus generic Scheme atomic data.
rust.source_delta_to_current: Current deriv.rs adds an explicit reject arm for the expanded shared Datum enum; frozen historical source/library remain paired with this artifact.
